title: Paper Coach Tutorial, version 2
description: Version 1 plus colour: a stroke may carry its own colour, and a step may fill shapes after its strokes. Fills are painted beneath every stroke, so outlines always stay on top. The web player reads versions 1 and 2; the iOS player reads version 1 only until M7.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within a tutorial library.

title.description: Human-readable name of the whole drawing.

steps.description: Ordered steps. The player pauses after each one.

canvas.description: Coordinate space for every coordinate and line width. Maps directly to the SVG viewBox.

color.description: Hex colour, as in version 1: #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA, with the leading # optional.

step.description: A step draws its strokes in order, then paints its fills in order. It needs at least one of either.

instruction.description: Shown to the learner while they copy the step onto paper.

voiceover.description: Reserved for a future version. Players ignore it.

strokes.description: Drawn strictly in order; stroke N+1 starts when N finishes. Empty in a step that only fills.

fills.description: Painted after the step's strokes, strictly in order, each beneath every stroke of the lesson.

d.description: SVG path data, absolute M/L/C/Q/Z only.

duration.description: Seconds to draw this stroke at 1x speed.

color.description: This stroke's colour, instead of style.strokeColor.

fill.description: A shape painted in one colour.

d.description: The shape as SVG path data, absolute M/L/C/Q/Z only. Several subpaths may make one shape, holes included.

duration.description: Seconds to paint this fill at 1x speed.

fillRule.description: Which parts of overlapping subpaths count as inside, as in SVG. Defaults to nonzero.
